title: Reading a Unity Script
introduction: A Unity script is a C# class that can use engine types and, when derived from MonoBehaviour, become a GameObject component.
learningOutcomes: Recognise the class and method structure of a Unity C# script.
Identify common C# and Unity value types.
Apply common C# naming conventions to simple declarations.

activities.question: Which base class lets a script be attached to a GameObject as a component?
activities.explanation: A class derived from MonoBehaviour can be attached to a GameObject as a component.

activities.question: A semicolon normally terminates a simple C# statement.
activities.explanation: Declarations, assignments and method calls are simple statements and normally end with a semicolon.
